subject: English
question_text: Write a dialogue between two friends how to improve
guide_solution: Dialogue writing A dialogue between two friends about how to improve language skill. Anas : Hello Asif! How are you? 126 Asif : I'm fine. What's about you? Anas : I'm fine too. What are you doing? Asif : I'm reading a book on improvement language skill. Anas : It's great. Because language skill is very important in our daily life. Asif : Do you read any book on it? Anas : Yes. I read some books and listen to my teachers in class and practice with others. Asif : By reading book, you can improve your language skill I mean. But you? Anas : You are right but only reading book you will not be able to improve your language skill properly. Besides this you can meet a good teacher and practice with the friends. Asif : I wish so. By the way, thank you for suggestions. Anas : No more today and thanks. Asif : You're welcome.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 77 — Police Lines School & College, Kushtia
